rC.density_assumption: monthly-mean thetao/so -> EOS-80 sigma0 (ref_pressure=None); umol/kg = mol/m3 * 1e6/rho

results.interpretation: WOA23 OMZ mean AOU = 271.3 umol/kg with a mean oxygen saturation of 11.3 %; the strongly elevated AOU together with the low saturation shows the 60 umol/kg zone is respiration-driven (oxygen consumed in situ), not merely a poorly ventilated water mass. Observed (WOA23) OMZ volume is 14.2e15 m3 at 20 umol/kg and 80.5e15 m3 at 60 umol/kg; GFDL-ESM4 historical gives 42.9 / 104e15 m3 and MPI-ESM1-2-LR 91.6 / 212e15 m3. GFDL-ESM4 reproduces the observed volume better (the other model's OMZ volume is further from the WOA23 value at both thresholds). Scenario change, ssp245 2071-2100 minus historical 1971-2000: GFDL-ESM4 -4.07 % (20 umol/kg) and +4.59 % (60 umol/kg); MPI-ESM1-2-LR -3.03 % and -0.71 %. The two models agree on the sign at the 60 umol/kg threshold (both shrink or disagree in sign), but they differ substantially in magnitude. CESM2 ssp245 is r10i1p1f1 and has no r10i1p1f1 historical counterpart, so no CESM2 scenario change can be formed.
